exposure: Planned cesarean hysterectomy for placenta accreta
outcome: Incidence of post-cesarean hysterectomy urinary incontinence
cohort: Women who underwent planned cesarean hysterectomy for placenta accreta and a control group of women who underwent scheduled cesarean section without hysterectomy
finding: Planned cesarean hysterectomy for placenta accreta may be a risk factor for urinary incontinence, though the difference was not statistically significant.
